title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Saturday, 26 September 2026
description: Today: Alibaba unveils a sweeping AI strategy including a planned 5-10 trillion parameter model and a new chip; new data shows youth mental health decline stabilising as Brisbane and Fremantle prepare for the AFL grand final; the Dolphins chase a preliminary final upset in Ray Stone's possible final NRL game; and Gold Coast prosecutors drop a murder charge in the decade-old Omega Ruston case. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
